description: `preflight-hard-adapter-named-effects`'s document, with the profile disabling `a`. Preflight walks the raw document, never the overlaid IR (settled ruling 7), so the missing-replies-file failure is still hard because of `a` and still names it -- a profile override is never consulted by preflight at all. The OS's own strerror text is third-party, masked by the conformance harness's own message-shape catalogue (tests/conformance/README.md); the errno and the path stay exact.
